parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Let your shoulders drop. <short pause> Let your jaw go slack. <short pause> You have carried enough today. <short pause> Breathe in slowly through your nose. <short pause> Breathe out through your mouth... letting the day fall away. <short pause> Again, breathe in... <short pause> and out.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: There is a veil between you and all that is broken. <short pause> Not a curtain you have hung yourself, straining to hold things back. <short pause> But a veil God has placed there... tender, and firm. <short pause> Behind it, he is working. <short pause> The fractures you cannot fix. The wounds you cannot reach. The sorrows too deep for words. <short pause> He tends them all... while you sleep.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You do not need to see his hands at work. <short pause> You do not need to understand the method. <short pause> He asks only that you rest. <short pause> Breathe in once more, slowly. <short pause> Breathe out... releasing what you cannot mend.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: This is not surrender to despair. <short pause> This is trust. <short pause> The God who knit you together in secret... knows every thread that has come loose. <short pause> He does not sleep. <short pause> He does not grow weary. <short pause> And while you lie here in the dark... he is faithful. <short pause> Scripture tells us this.
He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds. <short pause> Psalm one hundred forty-seven, verse three. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: He does not wait for you to be strong enough. <short pause> He does not require you to earn his care. <short pause> He heals because it is his nature. <short pause> And he binds up... because he loves.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let your breathing settle into its own rhythm now. <short pause> Let your body sink a little deeper. <short pause> The veil is still there. <short pause> And behind it, quiet work continues. <short pause> Stitches you cannot see. <short pause> Healing you cannot measure. <short pause> Grace that does not announce itself.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You are held. <short pause> You are tended. <short pause> And you are loved. <short pause> Rest now in that veiled harmony... where God works, and you are free to sleep.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: May he give you peace through the night.
